spec.assertion: distributedDamagePct 49.58 applies to self only and zeroing it lowers her total; a second pair of runs strips the burst hit's 'distributed' flavor and proves the buff then becomes an exact no-op. Fails under: stat authored but inert, off-self scoping, or the buff routed into a generic Damage-Up bucket instead of the distributed flavor.

coreDamagePct 25.25 self-only and load-bearing (zeroing lowers total, teammates byte-identical). Fails under: mis-encoding as generic attackDamagePct (would still move damage but would not carry the 25.25 coreDamagePct apply event) or omission.

critRatePct 16.73 present, self-only, load-bearing; and NO critRateNormalPct buff exists at value 16.73. Fails under the nearest-wrong scoped-crit encoding (critRateNormalPct), which would under-credit her burst/skill crit.

spec.kitLine: Activates only when Stage N at max
spec.assertion: it.skip - no at-max-stacks gate primitive; any faithful encoding (rampSec passive or resource+resourceGate) emits an identical buffApply, so ramp-in and post-reload flicker are unobservable.

Stage-1 ATK apply count over 180s must land in [400, 6000], the band spanned by both the 2-pulls (~1.2k) and 2-rounds (~2.5k) readings. Fails under a burstCast/fullBurstEnter mis-key (~4 applies) or an interval mis-key (tens). Pulls-vs-rounds itself is flagged and it.skip'd.

Both pairs apply to self with maxStacks 10 and observed peak stacks >= 9. Fails under a collapsed pre-summed model (110.3% ATK / 61.1% Hit Rate single buff) and under a stack cap that never saturates.
Same literal-magnitude + cap-saturation assertion as S1, at 2.71 / 4.9 with maxStacks 10.
Same, at 4.08 / 7.36 with maxStacks 5 (slack of 1 stack allowed because the 0.5s window can lapse on the same frame the 5th stack lands).

Zeroing every hitRatePct lowers her total (hit rate lifts core rate via hrCoreMult) with teammates unmoved. Fails under the common drop-Hit-Rate-as-defensive model, which leaves the run byte-identical to base.

spec.kitLine: Each stage triggers all before it
spec.assertion: it.skip - cumulative stacking is already implied by all six buffs co-existing at steady state; the prerequisite ordering is damage-visible only during the opening ramp and post-reload rebuild.

attackDamagePct 57.08 self-only, applied >= 2 times (her cast count), load-bearing; duration counterfactuals pin the window as bounded - patching to 1s lowers the total AND patching to 30s raises it. Fails under a permanent (no durationSec) encoding, which cannot be improved by widening.

Applies self-only exactly as often as the Attack Damage line (same Affects-self header), and zeroing it strictly lowers total damage - reload speed gates shots fired. Fails under the drop-as-defensive model. Teammate inertness intentionally not asserted (shot count feeds burst gauge).

Removing all damage effects from the burst slot drops exactly castCount() burst-srcSlot damage events and lowers her total with teammates unmoved - i.e. one instant hit per cast. Fails under a dot or per-shot-rider encoding (delta >> casts). Its distributed flavor is proven by the skill1-A flavor-strip pair.
it.skip - damage events carry no slug, so her own burst hit cannot be isolated from the global stream to read core / fbMajorApplied / rangeApplied.

fixtures: Single fixture: controlComp('quency-escape-queen', true) = liter B1 / crown B2 / quency B3 / helm B3, Fire boss, focus quency. B1+B2 are mandatory because a lone Burst III unit casts zero bursts (and her whole burst block would then be vacuous). helm is kept even though she is a second B3: every assertion is a within-fixture counterfactual (base vs withPatchedOverride run), so helm's constant contribution cancels, and her presence is handled by counting quency's ACTUAL casts via her unique self-buff (attackDamagePct 57.08) rather than assuming one cast per rotation. 13 hoisted runs: base, one zeroing run per kit stat (distributed / core / crit / atkPct / hitRatePct / attackDamagePct / reloadSpeedPct), burst-damage removal, a flavor-strip pair for the distributed-flavor interaction, and two burst-duration runs (1s / 30s).
gaps: skill1 'Activates only when Explore Route Stage N is at max stacks' (all three lines) - no at-max-stacks gate primitive; rampSec-passive and resource+resourceGate encodings are event-indistinguishable, so ramp-in and the post-reload flicker (81f reload exceeds the 1s and 0.5s tier windows) cannot be discriminated.

skill2 cross-stage prerequisites (stage 2 needs stage 1 at max, stage 3 needs stage 2 at max) - same missing primitive; all tiers saturate in steady state so the ordering is visible only in the ~1-2s opening ramp.
skill2 stack durations 2s / 1s / 0.5s - no buffRemove on natural lapse and no apply-frame field to pair with expiresFrame, so the windows are encoded but unassertable.
burst nuke non-core / full-burst-exempt / range-exempt properties - damage events carry no slug, so her own burst hit cannot be isolated from the global event stream.

'after 2 normal attacks' pulls-vs-rounds (hitsPerShot 2) - MEASUREMENT-GATED; both readings fall inside the asserted cadence band, and the 2x difference only shows in the post-reload stack rebuild. Recipe: popup-count the first magazine after a reload against the ATK ladder.
